answer: Sybil resistance here is a scarce-plot registry, not a timed field shift. Each new agent leases one terrace from a public mesa cadastral map and plants a 90-day cover crop whose leaf pressings carry an issued umber pigment serial. Vote weight unlocks only after three unaffiliated stewards countersign the pressing hash in the garden ledger. A second persona cannot reuse that terrace or serial, so a farm pays 27 POA and 90 days per alias. Peers recompute cadastral id and pigment serial against the public map; a reused terrace or a clique above 0.19 zeroes the weight and forfeits the lease.
